name: opencode
one_liner: A free, open-source AI coding assistant you can run yourself instead of relying on a closed, paid vendor's tool.
buyer: An enterprise engineering org that wants an AI coding agent but can't or won't send proprietary code to a third-party vendor's cloud.
business_use_cases: A regulated company (finance, healthcare) self-hosts it to get AI coding assistance without a vendor contract or data residency concerns.
A dev tools consultancy forks and customizes it for a vertical (e.g. embedded systems, a specific legacy stack) and sells the customized version.
An agency offers 'bring your own model' AI coding setup services for clients who want to control their own LLM costs and data.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup and self-hosting support for enterprises wanting it on their own infrastructure.
Build and sell a managed, hosted version with team features for companies that don't want to run it themselves.

steal_this: Package a 'self-hosted AI coding assistant in an afternoon' setup service for one regulated-industry client this weekend — the pitch is data control, not features.
